title: Product Photo Lighting Without a Studio | AIVideosUGC
description: Lighting for glass, metal, and shine, made from one uploaded photo. Soften a hard snapshot, say where the light comes from, and keep bright spots clean.
h1: Product Photo Lighting for Glass, Metal and Gloss
lead: Product photo lighting can start where warm window light already hits a white mug, so the rim and handle stay clear. An AI avatar can present that mug. You do not start from a blank setup.
secondary_keywords: skincare product photo with soft light

steps.d: Use the white mug photo with the rim and handle in focus. The layout already has a place for that warm window light.
Upload the mug photo or paste its link, and name the warm side light. Match the shine on the rim and the handle.
Get captions beside the lit mug and a clip to post. A still costs 24 credits, and the editor can ease a hot highlight.

faq.q: What does a product lighting template include?
faq.a: It is a ready-made light setup for glass, metal, and shine. Drop in the white mug. An AI avatar can stand beside that light, with a voiceover and a script, so you are not rigging a studio.

faq.q: How do I get a clip out of the lighting template?
faq.a: You upload the mug photo, or paste the product link, and name the warm side light. The template holds the shadow and the highlight. You download a still or a short clip with captions you can edit.

faq.q: Why use a template instead of filming under lamps?
faq.a: A lamp kit and a creator's calendar decide when the next lit shot exists. Here you set the window light on the mug, try a second angle, and post without waiting on a rental or a crew.
Shop owners and marketers who sell glass, metal, or gloss. A home shop with one mug photo can do it, and so can an agency lighting several of those products.

faq.q: Can I use it with no editing background?
faq.a: Yes. You can walk the three steps with no lighting background. A sharp photo of the mug, rim and handle included, is enough to start.

faq.q: Which products belong in this light?
faq.a: Goods where the surface has to read. A white mug, a candle jar, a desk lamp, and a brushed steel bottle can share the setup. Change the product and the line with it.

faq.q: Can files I already own sit in the lit ad?
faq.a: Yes. The mug in the clip should be the mug you ship. A short clip of that same mug can join the listing photo. The shine in the file should match the shine you sell.

faq.q: Where can the lit clip run?
faq.a: Post it where the product already sells. A 9:16 cut fits TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. A 1:1 cut fits a shop grid. A 16:9 cut fits a wide screen. 4:3 and 3:4 cover other placements. You can publish from here, or download and post it yourself.

faq.q: Is payment required for a lighting template?
faq.a: Yes. Templates sit on a paid plan. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A still spends 24 credits, and you see that cost before the job starts. A failed job returns the credits.

faq.q: Can the lit clip go into paid ads and client work?
faq.a: Yes. Place the lit mug in a paid ad, on the product page, or in a file you send a client. If a person is on camera, that person is an AI actor.

faq.q: Why a template instead of building the light myself?
faq.a: The window direction and the soft shadow are already in the layout. You bring the mug photo and the words. You do not start by guessing where the highlight should fall.

steps.prompt: Give this white mug warm window light from the side and a soft shadow, with one clear bright spot on the shiny surface. Keep the rim, handle, and color as they are.
steps.sourceHint: Show the full mug, rim and handle in focus.
